name: Oberoi Realty Ltd.
business_summary: Mumbai-focused luxury developer and annuity owner: residential (Worli, Goregaon/Borivali, Thane, Mulund), commercial (Commerz I-III, Oberoi Garden City), Oberoi Mall and hotels; recently open to land buys and JDs in Delhi-NCR (Business Standard 2026-10-19). Lowest leverage in the sector (interest Rs 205 cr TTM against operating profit Rs 3,560 cr). Q2 FY27 PAT ~Rs 762 cr (flat) with revenue -6%, but pre-sales beat Nomura's estimates; second interim dividend Rs 2/share. Market cap Rs 63,474 cr, P/E 24, ROCE 17.3%.

exposures.mechanism: Luxury/premium Mumbai (Worli, Borivali/Goregaon, Thane, Mulund, Sky City) is ~55-60% of value; rest commercial/retail/hospitality annuity (model estimate). +10% volume -> pre-sales +10% -> resi EBITDA +11% (high margin ~57% TTM op margin) -> group +6% x EV/MCap 1.05 x persistence 0.55 => ~+3.5. Anarock: only +3% y/y in Jul-Sep 2026; Oberoi pre-sales beat Nomura (2026-10-19).

evidence.note: Anarock via Economic Times 2026-09-28: Jul-Sep 2026 housing sales +3% y/y to just over 1 lakh units across top 7 cities
Nomura 2026-10-19: Buy, TP Rs 2,090 as pre-sales beat; ICICI Sec TP 2,151, Motilal 2,145 (2026-10-21/22)
